items.item_text: Master’s in health physics or related field
This position serves as both the Health Physics Department Director and theRadiation Safety Officer (RSO) for UC Davis Health and UC Davis academic campus.
50% - Radiation Safety Officer, Radiation Use Committee leadership and oversight

As Health Physics Department Director, the position leads Health Physics and certain Medical Physics operations, supervises five direct reports and indirectly oversees four additional FTEs, and holds signature authority and fiscal responsibility for the Health Physics budget.
50% - Health Physics/Medical Physics Program Operation Leader

As the Radiation Safety Officer, the position leads the radiation safety program, oversees compliance with applicable regulations, license conditions, and accreditation standards, and provides technical leadership to the Radiation Use Committee. The RSO establishes safety requirements and exposure controls for ionizing and non-ionizing radiation, including radioactive materials, X-ray equipment, and lasers. The RSO also oversees personnel dosimetry and training, radioactive materials inventory and disposal, program audits, and incident investigation and reporting. The RSO serves as a technical liaison to regulators, reviews facility plans, and verifies that construction meets radiation safety requirements.
In depth knowledge of Joint Commission
